title: One universal core skill set: lead, lanes, handoff, retro, architecture
body:
Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-skills-1115l.md slice 2
Why: KRN runs hand-written krn-lead/krn-handoff/krn-retro while adopted repos get thinner delivery-lead/delivery-retro; hooks name krn-handoff and krn-lead (src/context/gauge.ts:233, scripts/codex/context-hook.ts:201, src/successor/watchdog.ts:121) which outside repos never receive.
Outcome: src/adopt/skills/{delivery-lead (+lanes.md), delivery-handoff, delivery-retro, architecture} carry the full procedure with no KRN-only text (that moves to docs/program/lead-rules.md and repository-workflow.md); hook strings name the delivery-* skills; global-standards links architecture only (typescript leaves UNIVERSAL_SKILLS).
Files: src/adopt/skills/, docs/program/lead-rules.md, docs/program/repository-workflow.md, src/context/gauge.ts, src/successor/watchdog.ts, scripts/codex/context-hook.ts, src/brain/global-standards.ts, test/adopt/universal-skills.test.ts
Proof: universal-skills test: no KRN path, gate or operator text; every krn command resolves in src/cli/help.ts; every skill a hook names is in universalSkills().
Predicted: outside sessions <= 1 in >= 3 rows
